message.content: {"caption":"A loop diagram showing a language model proposing a task for one environment and solving the resulting problem with feedback from another.","description":"A loop connects a green circle on the left labeled “Environment e, f,” a central “Language Model,” and a green circle on the right labeled “Environment e.” The central model is shown as overlapping rounded blocks: a salmon block labeled π^propose and a purple block labeled π^solve. On the left side, an upper curved arrow labeled τ points from the model toward the left environment; a lower arrow labeled “(x, y*), r^propose” points from the left environment back toward the model. On the right side, an upper curved arrow labeled y points from the model toward the right environment; a lower curved arrow labeled r^solve points from the right environment back toward the model. Together, these arrows depict task proposal and environment validation on the left, followed by solving and reward feedback on the right.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
